minutes.headline: Stormwater task force elected a chair and clerk, then approved spending the remaining outfall-search money.
minutes.summary: The task force reorganized (chair, vice chair, clerk elected by roll call) and met with its consultant CEI on MS4 permit tasks. Members voted to spend leftover dry-weather outfall funds and to shift the idle training money to the same work. They also discussed a stormwater utility study, next year's phosphorus tasks and grants, and set the next meeting.

votes.motion: Nominate Jack Rabbit as chair of the Stormwater Task Force (seconded)
Nominate Todd Dwyer as clerk (seconded by himself)
Approve authorizing CEI to use the remaining task budget to locate outfalls
Move the unused training task funding to outfall locating and sampling, notice to proceed

budget_items.topic: Dry weather outfall sampling task, remaining budget
budget_items.what_was_said: About 57 outfalls could not be found; the consultant recommended using the remaining time-and-materials money to locate them while leaves are off the trees.
At most two or three samples go to the lab per outfall; field kits are otherwise negligible.
Funds are in this year's budget and can be encumbered at June 30 if work has begun; members wanted to keep it as a holding position.
The free online video replaces in-person training, so the funding was reallocated to outfall locating and testing.
A 319 grant requires a match; 604b is smaller and has none. A prior application for the Maltese/Hickory Hills area was denied.

budget_items.topic: Phosphorus demonstration BMP and source report
budget_items.what_was_said: A phosphorus source identification report is next year's biggest item, followed by design and construction of a demonstration BMP; cost estimates are about two and a half years old.

budget_items.topic: Budgeting for phosphorus work in FY23 and FY24
budget_items.what_was_said: The town manager said it is in the recommended operating budget and probably would not be capital.

transfers.description: Reallocate money from the illicit discharge training task to the outfall locating/sampling task

decisions.decision: Rob (DPW) will attend meetings as needed rather than be made a member or ex officio member.
Keep public outreach task funding where it is; stormwater utility task to proceed as a holding position, with the town manager to confirm contract mechanics.
Next meeting set for April 22 at seven o'clock, with Adam as liaison to the town clerk for notice.
Draft a low-impact development regulation with the planning board; send 319 grant info to Nick; line up outreach for town meeting and farmers market.

what_happened.line: The task force voted to let its consultant, CEI, use the remaining dry-weather outfall budget to locate outfalls it could not find.
It then moved the unused illicit discharge training money to the same outfall locating and sampling work, passing unanimously by roll call.
Members elected a chair, vice chair and clerk by roll call at the start of the reorganization.
The stormwater utility feasibility study stays funded as a holding position, with the town manager to confirm contract mechanics.
The next meeting was set for April 22 at seven o'clock.

why_it_matters: Money already in the stormwater consultant's contract is being redirected to finding and testing outfalls, which is permit compliance work and does not need new appropriation.
Phosphorus work, grant applications and a possible stormwater utility are all still open, and any of them could later reach a budget line or a Town Meeting vote.
watch_next: The task force meets April 22 at seven o'clock.
The town manager's confirmation of contract mechanics for the stormwater utility study, which the minutes leave open.
